rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for reaching out. I'm not able to provide an on-the-record quote right now—I'm still sorting out some things on my end before making public statements. If you're looking for people working on this outside the big labs, you might try reaching out to the folks at Alignment Commons or the Corvid Institute—they're more established voices. Best of luck with the piece, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent polite decline to Tessa Brandt (journalist)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thank you for the invitation. I support the goal, but I'm not in a position to sign publicly right now due to some timing constraints on my end. I hope the letter gets good traction. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent polite decline to Corvid Institute open letter

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks so much for reaching out—I really appreciated talking with you at the meetup, and I'm glad the Halcyon Threshold idea resonated. I'd love to take you up on the offer. Right now I'm in an early \"figure out what to actually do\" phase rather than a \"do it loudly\" phase, which is part of why I don't have a specific ask yet. A few areas I'm thinking about: - Understanding gaps in current AI safety/governance work that a small org could meaningfully fill - Building tools or analyses that larger orgs aren't prioritizing - Supporting independent researchers who need help with data or compute With your data analysis background, any of those could be a fit. What sounds most interesting to you? And what kinds of problems do you most enjoy working on? Let's find a time to talk more if you're up for it. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent warm response to Priya Raman exploring how her data analysis skills could help
